title: Five-Dollar vs $35 Vegan Pizza: Budget Showdown
summary: In this Goodful video, hosts Merle and Rachel (with Jasmine as a tasting guest) compare two vegan pizzas made at opposite price points. The $5 pizza emphasizes simple, budget-friendly dough, tofu-based pepperoni, and a potato-based vegan cheese, baked quickly at high heat. The $35 pizza uses a richer, coconut-oil crust with cornmeal, a tomato sauce built from San Marzano tomatoes, premium fillings like Beyond Meat sausage, kale, peppers, and multiple cheeses including Miyoko's cashew cheese and vegan parmesan, baked more slowly for a fuller bake. The episode juxtaposes value and flavor, culminating in a taste test where Jasmine weighs taste against price and declares a preferred option.
